title: NL-Augmenter A Framework for Task-Sensitive Natural Language Augmentation
findings: The paper presents a framework that includes a 'Universal Bias Filter' designed to measure representational balance for categories such as religion. However, the paper does not report specific experimental results or findings related to the performance of models on the religion category.
